# OphirPay secrets-scan negative control (issue #393)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# This file intentionally contains NO secrets. The `secrets-scan` CI job
# scans it and expects gitleaks to return a clean result (exit 0), proving
# the blocklist does not false-positive on ordinary text.

This is an ordinary configuration note with no credential-shaped values.
The rate limit is 5,000 requests per hour and the retry backoff is 30 seconds.
Contact the on-call engineer through the internal Slack channel #payments-infra.
